name: Color shaded relief
description: Use global MGS MOLA color shading for broad surface and topographic context; image colors are not route elevation samples.

name: Viking color mosaic
description: Compare Jezero with a historic global color mosaic from the Viking orbiter era.

name: MOLA + HRSC color hillshade
description: NASA Trek orbital topographic image context; raster color is not a route elevation measurement.

name: MOLA + HRSC hillshade
description: Grayscale MOLA and HRSC hillshade from NASA Trek for regional relief context.

name: Terrain watch zones
description: Illustrative zones make route tradeoffs visible; they are not validated terrain hazards.

name: Science points
description: Approximate mission and geology annotations help connect a traverse with published science context.

name: HiRISE DTM footprints
description: Footprints of 1,300+ HiRISE Digital Terrain Models (1–2 m posts) from the PDS DTM index, listed on data.nasa.gov. Shows where finer elevation exists; the app does not sample it.

name: IAU feature names
description: IAU-adopted names of craters, valleys and mountains from the Gazetteer of Planetary Nomenclature on data.nasa.gov. Smaller features appear as you zoom in.

name: Mission landing sites
description: NASA landers and rovers with the count of their datasets in the data.nasa.gov Mars catalog. Select a site to open its data shelf.
